description: Three consecutive words where BOTH the first-two and the last-two are independently approved bigrams, sharing the middle word. Only the LEFTMOST (greedy left-to-right, non-overlapping) may fire -- the middle word can't be consumed by two substitutions in the same pass. Confirmed at heavy severity (k=2) that only 1 substitution happens even though k=2 would otherwise allow a second, because only 1 non-overlapping occurrence actually exists in the eligible pool.
